description: Reads Unreal Engine files by their magic. .uasset/.umap: the package summary (engine and object versions, flags such as cooked or unversioned properties), the name table, imports (class, object, outer as a path) and exports (object, class, size), with the main asset and the packages it references; property bodies are not read. IoStore .utoc: header, compression methods and, when the directory index is there and not encrypted, the file list with sizes. .locres: namespaces, keys and texts (versions 0-3). GVAS .sav: header and the tagged properties with their values (UE 4.x to 5.3). Accepts UE4 214-522 and UE5 1000-1018 packages, also unversioned cooked ones when the tables fit; anything else stops with partial and the reason instead of guessing. Read-only: encrypted or Oodle-compressed data is reported, never opened. For .pak archives use re_archive.

match.description: Only names/paths/keys matching: substring, glob or /regex/.

name: re_unreal
title: Read Unreal packages, IoStore, locres and saves
